skills: Up to 4 Electric hits; the 4th is invulnerable. Its final hit on an enemy with any Attribute Anomaly triggers Lightning Lash (2% of the Disorder DMG plus 360% of her Anomaly Proficiency).

With 80+ Improvised Overture, hold to spend 80 on a massive Electric hit. On Electric Anomaly it extends the Anomaly to 10s instead of applying a new one; on any other Anomaly it triggers Polarity Disorder (60% of the Disorder DMG, and the Anomaly stays). Invulnerable.
Parries the attack for massive Daze. Invulnerable.
After a Defensive Assist: a swift Electric slash. Invulnerable.

With enough Energy: an Electric slash that enters Hunting Prelude and triggers Vital View. In Hunting Prelude she can use up to 3 EX Slash or EX Shot in a row; dodge or wait to leave. Leaving without using an EX Special costs 20 Energy. Invulnerable.

In Hunting Prelude, spends Energy on an Electric slash. The final hit on an enemy with an Attribute Anomaly triggers Lightning Lash (7% of the Disorder DMG plus DMG from her Anomaly Proficiency); on Shock it applies no new Anomaly and the Arc ignores 20% Electric RES. Hold to fire the last slash early. Invulnerable.
In Hunting Prelude, spends Energy on shots at surrounding enemies for Electric DMG, with +50% Anomaly Buildup Rate on enemies without Shock. Hold to fire the final round early. Invulnerable.
Consecutive attacks for massive Electric DMG. Invulnerable.
At max Decibels: a rapid flurry of slashes for massive Electric DMG. Invulnerable.

core.name: Lightning Lash
core.text:
Anomaly Proficiency +84. EX Special Attacks restore 10 Improvised Overture.
When an enemy with an Attribute Anomaly attacks, it triggers 1 Lightning Lash: 3% of the original Disorder DMG plus 460% of her Anomaly Proficiency, bouncing to up to 3 nearby enemies with 50% less DMG per bounce (once per enemy every 10s; she recovers 3 Improvised Overture). All Lightning Lash DMG counts as Disorder DMG.
The whole squad's Disorder DMG can CRIT, with a base 100% CRIT Rate and 35% CRIT DMG.

ability.name: Forgiveness Isn't Mercy
ability.text: With a Support or another Anomaly squadmate: Shock she applies lasts 3s longer, and Disordered Echo can extend Electric Anomaly to 13s. On entering combat or when a squadmate applies an Attribute Anomaly, each 0.12 of initial Energy Regen above 1.2 gives +10 Anomaly Mastery (max +140) for 30s.
